gloss: start of autumn; first day of autumn

definitions.gloss: start of autumn; first day of autumn
definitions.explanation: one of the 24 solar terms ({二十四節気|にじゅうしせっき}) in the traditional East Asian calendar, marking the beginning of autumn, usually falling around August 7-8

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{立秋|りっしゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{八月|はちがつ}→八月：00626_hachigatsu⟧⟦{七日|なのか}→七日：02927_nanoka⟧だ。
examples.english: This year's start of autumn is August 7th.

examples.japanese: {立秋|りっしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎて→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Even after the start of autumn, hot days continue.

examples.japanese: {立秋|りっしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{暑中見舞|しょちゅうみま}い→暑中見舞い：23502_shochuumimai⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{残暑見舞|ざんしょみま}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつけよう→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧。
examples.english: After the start of autumn, summer greetings change from 'mid-summer greetings' to 'lingering heat greetings,' so pay attention to the timing.

notes:
One of the ⟦{二十四節気|にじゅうしせっき}→二十四節気：25146_nijuushisekki⟧ (24 solar terms) used in the traditional calendar. Despite the name, {立秋|りっしゅう} falls in early August when temperatures are still at their peak in Japan, so it marks the calendrical rather than the meteorological start of autumn.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {立秋|りっしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to reach the start of autumn
- {立秋|りっしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: to pass the start of autumn
- {立秋|りっしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{候|こう}: seasonal greeting phrase used around this time

CULTURAL NOTE:
{立秋|りっしゅう} has practical significance for seasonal greetings. Before {立秋|りっしゅう}, summer greeting cards are called ⟦{暑中見舞|しょちゅうみま}い→暑中見舞い：23502_shochuumimai⟧. After {立秋|りっしゅう}, they must be called {残暑見舞|ざんしょみま}い instead. Sending the wrong type is considered a social faux pas.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{立春|りっしゅん}→立春：22417_risshun⟧: start of spring (around February 4)
- ⟦{立夏|りっか}→立夏：20374_rikka⟧: start of summer (around May 6)
- ⟦{立冬|りっとう}→立冬：26312_rittou⟧: start of winter (around November 7)
